title: It worked! but the original intention is changing the font of the title. ^^;

posts.author: DeadManDan98
posts.body:
I had somehow changed the font style of this, I am proud but the original execution behind it was to change the title font style.
Had to change the font size to 34 eariler to see better.
Edit #1: I had forgotten to recheck the "Draw Game Title" box. So here it is.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Keep in mind that changing a window's or sprite's font can override the default name.
Inside a window
Ruby:
self.contents.font.name = "Your Name"
Inside a sprite
Ruby:
self.bitmap.font.name = "Your Name"
An array is also allowed there.
